==Description==
The '''Mecha Bunny + Nerd Ducky Mini Plush''' is an official plush toy based on the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] and its mech from the [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. It was released on the 18th of April 2025, and is manufactured by Juniper Creates™. The plush features [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] seated inside the chest of Mecha Bunny, secured with velcro and is fully detachable. It is made from soft silver plush fabric with detailed embroidery.

Anybody who bought the toy from the in-game Merch Store will receive the {{Color|Other|Mecha Bunny}} skin for the in-game [[Cowboy]]. If bought on the [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games store], it will not come with any rewards.

The plush measures approximately 9.4 inches (23.876 cm) in height, 11 inches (27.94 cm) in width and 9.8 inches (24.892 cm) in depth. It is filled with Polypropylene cotton and covered in plush fabric. A tree is planted for every plush purchased. This item is available for a limited time only.

==Official Description==
*'''Online (Third)'''
*:He is big. He is bad. He is bunny-shaped. With Nerd Ducky at the controls, this Mecha Bunny mini plush is ready to cause chaos and conquer your heart with a single quack. The in-game reward is only included with purchases made in Roblox. Items purchased from shop.paradoxum.games do not include an in-game reward.
*'''Online (Second)'''
*:He’s big. He’s bad. He’s bunny-shaped, and he's 10% off until April 21! With Nerd Ducky at the controls, this Mecha Bunny mini plush is ready to cause chaos and conquer your heart with a single quack.
*'''Online (First)'''
*:He’s big. He’s bad. He’s bunny-shaped, and he's 10% off until April 21! With Nerd Ducky at the controls, this Mecha Bunny mini plush is ready to cause chaos and conquer your heart with a single quack. Plus, score a FREE in-game skin with your purchase!

==Prices & Stores==
Prices may vary by country due to shipping fees and local currency. The '''Mecha Bunny + Nerd Ducky Mini Plush''' is priced at $23.99, discounted from $29.99.

Originally, it had a cost of $27.99.

During the Easter Sale, which coincided with its launch, it is available for a discounted price of $25.19. The plush can currently be purchased from the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store].
